title: feat(formula, plugin-email, lint)!: a mail template hole whose formatter the whitelist does not name is refused by name, never rendered raw
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-support-ai"} -->
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwBPZ1A9daZqRh23Ponr9G4xe)_

Fixes #26948

Clause-②: no (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: narrowed
Skills-docs: none — `skills/objectstack-formula/SKILL.md:444` already teaches the formatter whitelist as `TEMPLATE_FORMATTERS`, which is exactly the rule this PR enforces, and no `skills/**` file teaches or shows a mail hole whose formatter is outside it (grep over `skills/**` for `formatter`, `email template` and `emailTemplates`: none of the hits teaches a mail formatter name); the docs page `content/docs/automation/email-templates.mdx` gains the refusal here.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:邮件模板里写错或不存在的格式化器(如 `{{ amount | curency:EUR }}`)现在在 `os validate` / `os build` / `os lint` 和元数据发布门(`422 INVALID_METADATA`)被按名拒绝,并列出全部可用格式化器;已存的旧模板渲染时报 `TEMPLATE_INVALID`,不再发出原始值。
- 为什么改:原来邮件照常发出,金额处显示 `1234.5`、日期处显示原始时间戳,作者毫无提示;应用内模板早就拒绝这种写法,两种方言不一致。
- 风险与回滚:收窄(BREAKING),只影响拼错格式化器的模板;仓内出厂模板、示例、种子、技能零命中。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看:`packages/formula/src/template-engine.ts`(`judgeHoleFormatter` 新增的 `known-formatter` 规则)、`packages/plugins/plugin-email/src/template-engine.ts`(去掉原始值回退)、`content/docs/automation/email-templates.mdx`。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint exec vitest run src/validate-email-template-hole-grammar.unknown-formatter.test.ts`,预期 8/8 通过(三个面、三条命令、发布门各被拒)。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地(须在 #26937 之后落地,届时合入 main)。

## What changes

- **`@objectstack/formula`, `judgeHoleFormatter`** (`template-engine.ts`): a third rule, `known-formatter`, judged after `one-formatter` and before the `currency` argument. A hole whose formatter is a single word that `TEMPLATE_FORMATTERS` does not hold is refused, and the sentence names the hole and lists every known formatter. `TemplateHoleGrammarRule` gains `'known-formatter'`. The check reads the exported list, so an inherited object key (`toString`, `constructor`) is not a formatter either.
- **The mail grammar** (`mail-hole-grammar.ts`): no code change. `parseMailHole` already calls `judgeHoleFormatter`, so it now carries the refusal and `judgeMailHoleGrammar` reports the hole. Only its header names the new rule.
- **`@objectstack/plugin-email` renderer** (`template-engine.ts`): the `// unknown formatter → raw` fallback is gone. A refused hole throws `TEMPLATE_INVALID` from the grammar as the other refusals do, and `EmailService` prefixes the template and locale. If `formatValue` ever answered `undefined` for a name the grammar passed, the render throws `TEMPLATE_INVALID` too, so a raw value is never printed in its place.
- **`@objectstack/lint` `email-template-hole-grammar`**: no code change (it reads `judgeMailHoleGrammar`). It now refuses the hole at `os validate`, `os build`, `os lint` and the runtime publish gate. Only its header comment names the new case.
- **The in-app dialect**: its own parse already refused an unknown formatter and keeps its own sentence. One side effect: an inherited object key (`{{ x | toString }}`) used to pass `!FORMATTERS[name]` and run as a formatter, printing `[object Object]`. Now the shared rule refuses it.
- **Docs**: `content/docs/automation/email-templates.mdx` gains a paragraph on the rule. The `TEMPLATE_INVALID` TSDoc on `IEmailService.sendTemplate` / `renderTemplate` (`packages/spec/src/contracts/email-service.ts`) names the third hole it refuses.
- **Changesets**: formula, plugin-email and lint `minor` (narrowed, `(narrowing)` arm, ADR-0087 `not-required (no-migration-prescription)`: a conversion cannot know which formatter was meant), spec `patch` (TSDoc only, `none`). `@objectstack/metadata-protocol` gets only a new test file, which is not in its published `files`, so it has no entry.

### Census (on `origin/main` 72629f38)

I grepped every `{{ path | name` hole in the repo, excluding CHANGELOGs, release notes and generated translations. Then I checked each mail template carrier by hand: the showcase and app emails, `plugin-email` `auth-templates.ts`, the spec seeds, dogfood and downstream fixtures, the upgrade-harness SQL fixtures and `skills/**`. Examples 0, seeds 0, skills 0, apps 0. The only mail holes with a formatter are the `datetime:long` holes in `auth-templates.ts` and the docs examples, and all of them use known formatters. The unknown names the grep found (`bogus`, `nope`, `shout`, `no_such_formatter`) are in-app dialect tests. They are refused there already and their results do not change.

### Merge order with #26937 and #26939

**Serial with #26937 (merged at `22058635`).** This branch kept its hunks out of #26937's, and merged `main` once #26937 landed (`9b72c4e1`, no rebase). The one conflict was `TemplateHoleGrammarRule`. It now has five members: `one-formatter`, `known-formatter`, `currency-code-literal`, `currency-code-path-mail-only` and `currency-code-path-undeclared`. `judgeHoleFormatter` keeps #26937's `dialect` parameter, and `known-formatter` sits after `one-formatter` and before the currency block. `395c096e` adds the unknown-formatter clause to `MAIL_TEMPLATE_HOLES` and its comment (the `CURRENCY_ARGUMENT_RULE` sentence stays verbatim), and to the `validateEmailTemplateHoleGrammar` roster comment in `authoring-rules.ts`. It also widens the spec changeset and corrects the `IEmailService` TSDoc. `97613711` regenerates `content/docs/references/system/email-template.mdx`.

**Residual (follow-up #27225).** This PR refuses an unknown one-word formatter. Formatter text that is not one word (`{{ x | date-long }}`, `{{ x | currency :EUR }}`, `{{ x | two words }}`) fails `FILTER_RE` / `WORD_RE`, so `parseMailHole` answers `null`. Every mail door then accepts it and the renderer prints the hole verbatim (pinned at `text-field-html-outlets.pin.test.ts:284`), while the in-app dialect refuses it. #27225 carries that.

## Tests

- New `packages/formula/src/template-unknown-formatter.test.ts` (9 cases). It covers the refusal and its sentence, every whitelisted name passing, inherited keys refused, the one-formatter rule winning on a chained hole, non-word text left verbatim, `parseMailHole` / `judgeMailHoleGrammar` locating triple-braced holes, the in-app sentence unchanged, and in-app `toString` now refused.
- New `packages/plugins/plugin-email/src/template-unknown-formatter.render.test.ts` (5 cases). It covers `renderTemplate` on all three faces refused with the template, locale, hole and known list, `sendTemplate` sending nothing, and the corrected name rendering.
- Re-pinned `packages/plugins/plugin-email/src/template-engine.test.ts`: "falls back to the raw value for an unknown formatter (no throw)" is now "refuses an unknown formatter with TEMPLATE_INVALID, never the raw value", for both entry points.
- New `packages/lint/src/validate-email-template-hole-grammar.unknown-formatter.test.ts` (8 cases). It covers all three faces, `os validate` / `build` / `lint`, and the runtime publish gate.
- New `packages/metadata-protocol/src/runtime-authoring-gate.email-template-unknown-formatter.test.ts`. It checks the `422 INVALID_METADATA` envelope (`code` and `status`, plus `issues`), and that the corrected name publishes.

## Acceptance notes

- Text after the `|` that is not a single word (`{{ x | two words }}`, `{{ x | }}`) still names no formatter in the mail grammar and is left as written, as `text-field-html-outlets.pin.test.ts` pins. The in-app dialect refuses the same text as an invalid hole. This PR leaves that difference alone, because the card is about formatter names.
- In the ablation, the `sendTemplate` case and the re-pinned `template-engine.test.ts` case stayed green. That is the renderer's own `formatted === undefined` guard: it still throws `TEMPLATE_INVALID` when the grammar rule is removed. That is the intended second line, and the face cases, which assert the grammar's sentence, went red.

## Verification

Run on head 857e69625 (`origin/main` 72629f38 + 3 commits).
